memories-spa-takes-its-name: Memories Spa takes its name from the wish to be a salon that sits quietly alongside each woman’s everyday life, a place where ordinary days become memories.
it-is-a-private-women: It is a private, women-only space by reservation, where small dogs can stay by your side and shop dogs Latte and Mugi say hello.
mai-leads-yu-fai-thailands: Mai leads Yu-fai, Thailand’s traditional herbal heat therapy, and Nuat Thippaya, a massage that wraps the body in a long cloth.

yu-fai-thai-for-staying: Yu-fai, Thai for “staying by the fire”, is Thailand’s traditional herbal heat therapy.
rooted-in-more-than-2: Rooted in more than 2,600 years of Thai traditional medicine, it was handed down as postpartum care, helping new mothers recover their strength and their body return to its former state.
today-it-is-valued-well: Today it is valued well beyond the postpartum months, by any woman who struggles with feeling cold or with hormonal imbalance.
a-newer-technique-built-on: A newer technique built on Thai traditional medicine, now drawing attention worldwide and across Japan: massage and stretching through a long cloth.
wrapping-the-body-in-cloth: Wrapping the body in cloth softens the pinpoint pressure and friction of hands and fingers. It feels gentle on the skin and brings a deep sense of safety and relaxation.

yu-fai-herbal-heat-care: Yu-fai herbal heat care and Thip Paya cloth stretching, without acupuncture. Ideal before and after childbirth, while trying to conceive, through menopause, or whenever you want to loosen up from deep inside.
yu-fai-warms-you-to: Yu-fai warms you to the bone, acupuncture reaches deep, then a long Thip Paya cloth carries you through slow stretches using your own weight. A blend of treatment and relaxation for the ups and downs around childbirth and menopause, and for period pain.
memories-spa-also-offers-acupuncture: Memories Spa also offers acupuncture, beauty, aroma and herbal sauna menus.
a-private-salon-for-women: A private salon for women, offering Thai warming beauty-and-health care and acupuncture. Visits are by reservation only.

brand-line: The therapist who restores the body’s natural flow
hero-credentials: Thai government–certified · Therapist Chief at Memories Spa, Tsukuba
philosophy-lead: The body has a natural flow of its own. Everyday tiredness and tension slow it down; Mai finds where with her hands and patiently restores it, so the ease lasts beyond the treatment and into the days that follow.
pillar-understand-text: Where the body holds tension, where its flow has stalled. Mai reads it through her hands and helps you understand your own body.
pillar-restore-text: With warmth and technique she releases what has stiffened and brings the body back to its natural flow.
pillar-unlock-text: When the flow returns, the body can give its best again: at work, on stage, in competition.
for-performers-text: For people whose body is both their work and their way of expression. Mai looks after their everyday condition, so they can give everything when it matters.
for-women-text: A woman’s body changes with the years and with life. Mai works with each of those changes, supporting health and beauty from within.
vision-lead: Mai’s aim is to become the therapist people at the top of their field, anywhere in the world, trust with their bodies. She keeps refining her craft, one treatment at a time.
vision-learn-text: She is now studying acupuncture, to understand the body from another angle as well.
vision-teach-text: In time, she hopes to teach, so more people learn to understand their own bodies.
vision-research-text: She also hopes to take up research, sharing her techniques and knowledge in Japan and around the world.
dogs-text: Small dogs are welcome to come with you and stay relaxed by your side throughout your treatment.
dogs-hers: Mai’s own two dogs, Latte and Mugi, will be there to greet you.
dogs-note: Just let us know when you book.
